classification.notes: Article describes a Cboe Exchange rule change amending Global Trading Hours (GTH) and Curb Trading Hours sessions. This is an exchange-internal rule filing about trading session hours for options/futures on Cboe, not a market disruption, emergency closure, or extended trading hours initiative (like T+0 or 24x5) that would touch DTCC settlement processes. No card in the catalog maps to routine exchange trading-hours rule amendments of this nature. Content scope is headline-only with no additional detail to suggest a broader systemic impact.
